The search covers the registry's own const methods, its post-read initialization, and the direct callers of a const method that returns the key or a string field: their lookups and sprite changes of GUI elements after the call. Names that other code composes or looks up, such as interface code that reads a field without such a method or passes the name on to another function, and the run-time choice behind a selection condition, such as which swap the engine selects and whether it is valid, are outside it. The answer is no catalogue of the names that content defines.
